correctness.rationale: For every integer k>=1 and positive a,b with 0<w<1, differentiate the exact mixture. For k>=3, strict monotonicity of the logarithmic derivative of Phi gives exactly one maximum; derivative sign gives a boundary peak plus a later interior peak precisely below the critical weight. For k=2, the unique hump exists exactly for R>2; the level Phi(0)=1 yields the second cutoff. k=1 decreases. Rational substitution verifies identical mean, second moment and rate ratio for the contrasting k=3 cases. Rigorous rational exponential brackets place their weights on opposite sides of w*. Standard-library checker executed successfully with 800 sampled modal comparisons; finite comparisons are only corroborative.

value.rationale: Complete finite-stage sharp modality phase diagram for a natural parallel/serial-reservoir tracer idealization. It decides when a separate delayed concentration peak can coexist with the immediate release peak, including rate and mixing-weight boundaries. The exact equal-mean/equal-variance/equal-rate-ratio contrasting models show a nontrivial diagnostic limitation of low-order transit-time statistics. The result is structural rather than numerical fitting or arbitrary enumeration.
